title: Zero-sum triples of reconciliation deltas
insight: LeetCode 15 3Sum: sort, fix the smallest value, walk two pointers inward, skip duplicate values, O(n^2)
prompt: Reconciliation needs ZeroSumTriples implemented in triples.go. The exact output ordering, the de-duplication rules and the input sizes are in README.md. Keep the package name and exported signature, standard library only, and run `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` before you hand it back.
